transcript: Speaker A: This is a mountain. A mountain is very high. It is bigger than a hill. This is a desert. A desert is very dry. There is a lot of sand. This is an island. An island is land in water. Water is all around. This is a hill. A hill is small and not very high. It is lower than a mountain. This is a waterfall. Water falls down. It is strong and beautiful. This is a cave. A cave is inside a rock. It is dark. This is a forest. A forest has many trees. It is green and quiet.
